_format_note: Golden evaluation set schema: top level {'_format_note': str, 'cases': [case]}; case = {case_id, document:{filename(.md/.txt only), content_text}, question, expected:{kind:'hit'|'abstain', expected_locator_chunk_index (int|null), expected_answer_keywords (list[str])}, note (exact token-overlap arithmetic)}. Score = |distinct chunk tokens intersect distinct query tokens| / |distinct query tokens|; tokens = re.findall(r'[a-z0-9]+', text.lower()). Gate (mirrors rag /answer): abstain iff no documents OR no chunks OR best_score < rag.THRESHOLD. Documents seeded via documents.save (content_sha256 = id); locator = f'{content_sha256}--chunk-{n}' with n 1-based over paragraphs split on blank lines.
